entities.summary: Wendover is a town and civil parish at the foot of the Chiltern Hills in Buckinghamshire, England. It is situated at the point where the main road across the Chilterns between London and Aylesbury intersects with the once important road along the foot of the hill. The town lies 35 miles (56 km) north-west of London and 5 miles (8 km) south-east of Aylesbury.
